title: Tell us the problem
text: Call, WhatsApp a photo or use the form below.

title: Get a written price
text: Simple hardware jobs can often be priced from photos. Glass needs measuring.

title: Book a time that suits you
text: Visits are available seven days a week.

title: The repair
text: Most hinges, handles, locks and seals are fixed on the first visit. Sealed glass units are made to measure, so glass jobs usually need a second short visit to fit the new unit.
